name: IGEX
summary: IGEX was a historical international search for germanium-76 neutrinoless double-beta decay. It used enriched germanium crystals in underground low-background installations and developed pulse-shape rejection for later germanium programmes.
detection_principle: The enriched germanium crystal acts as both source and semiconductor calorimeter. Shielding, underground siting and pulse-shape selection suppress continuum backgrounds near the double-beta Q value.

results.summary: IGEX reported a lower bound on the 76Ge neutrinoless-decay half-life; it did not observe the decay.

science_scope: A neutrinoless double-beta-decay signal would establish lepton-number violation. Converting a half-life constraint into an effective Majorana mass requires a decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements; a null search is not a neutrino-mass measurement.
